edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Ghostwater Dive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
